data: Which of the following object locations are represented by arrows pointing in a rightwards direction?

The question asks which object locations are represented by arrows pointing in a rightwards direction. From the caption, we know that the figure shows Principal Component Analysis on the Cs neurons with different object locations. The arrows in the figure indicate the directions of the object locations.

Looking at the figure, there are two arrows visible. One arrow is pointing towards the right, and the other is pointing towards the left. The arrow pointing towards the right corresponds to the object location labeled 'pos 6'. Therefore, the object location represented by an arrow pointing in a rightwards direction is 'pos 6'.
